source_title: Specified transaction cash and performance definitions
unit: USD million except percentages and calendar years
facts: Deal cash metrics cover only the listed cash consideration and acquired cash, with Otezla as the sole specified required divestiture. They exclude transaction fees, financing flows and taxes. The source does not establish cash payment timing for the capitalized MyoKardia transaction costs. Do not infer that accounting cost is a cash payment. The disclosed transaction-cost amounts retain their source accounting bases: Celgene acquisition expenses and MyoKardia costs included in asset allocation. Zero components in acquisitions are structurally absent from the listed consideration, not a claim that every other possible transaction cash flow was zero. For cash_coverage, retain the reported operating cash and investing-category totals. Do not attempt to allocate the remaining acquisition/other payments to individual undisclosed fees or other transactions. Equity and debt financing and marketable-security turnover are outside the requested cash remainder. The earnings diagnostic excludes only acquisition-date MyoKardia expenses and all contingent-consideration fair-value changes in 2020. Keep other income-statement items unchanged and make no tax adjustment. It is not issuer non-GAAP earnings or a fully normalized continuing-business result. The revenue comparison uses actual 2020 revenue and the supplied 2019 Celgene/Otezla pro forma baseline. It does not assert constant currency, organic growth or a forecast. Source pro forma qualifications remain applicable.

This split combines the allocation footnote with the earnings statement rather than increasing the precision of the rounded 11.4 billion wording.
